stop_policy: First exact complete four-channel solution or twelve scenarios; each failure stops that scenario. No x4 expansion. Fixed original all-hole projection model. No source via, pad, width, clearance, grid or process changes.

algorithm_changes.simplification: collinear compression only, no angle-changing shortcut
algorithm_changes.offset: explicit miters; no library self-intersection repair; full polylines checked
algorithm_changes.raster_connectivity_precheck: 4-connected free-cell components, sufficient no-path test for 8-neighbor graph with no corner cutting
